tare_F3: median M of all CUB and OQ arrays on the array's own slide
amended: 2026-10-13, after calibration began and before any reading: verdict label for F1-not-met changed from BROKEN to not-ruled-out; F5 descriptive added; bars unchanged (author)
rule: F1 MET if M(OQ)/M(CUB) > 1 in >= crit_F1 of the F1 patients; F2 MET if M(TU)/M(OQ) > 1 in >= crit_F1 of them; F3 MET if the slide-tared OQ/CUB ratio > 1 in >= crit_F3 of the F3 patients; F4 and F5 descriptive only. F1 not met with F2 met means no difference between a woman's two breasts; it does NOT rule out a field covering both breasts or the whole body.
